Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Store hublot?

In this glossary, Store hublot refers to: Movable blind covering a passenger window to regulate light during flight phases.

How is Store hublot used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sol, le store hublot du siège 20C est bloqué à mi-course et ne peut être ouvert pour l’inspection extérieure ; maintenance requise avant repoussage."

Why does Store hublot matter in aviation?

Store hublot matters because it supports clear communication in Cabin contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Store hublot?

Store hublot is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Store hublot belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Movable blind covering a passenger window to regulate light during flight phases.

Operational example

Ground, window shade in seat two-zero-Charlie is jammed halfway and cannot be fully opened for external inspection; maintenance required before pushback.
